name: Indo Tech Transformers Limited
about: Indo Tech Transformers Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of transformers in India and internationally. The company offers distribution and power transformers; large power transformers, including generator step up/down, two and three winding, and auto transformers, as well as skid-mounted substations. It serves various sectors, such as transmission, generation, hydro, wind, solar, steel, cement, textiles, utilities, DESCOMS etc. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Kancheepuram, India. Indo Tech Transformers Limited operates as a subsidiary of Shirdi Sai Electricals Limited.
